1. (Currently amended) An airfoil for a turbine engine comprising: an airfoil having pressure and suction sides and extending in a radial direction from a 0% span position at an inner flow path location to a 100% span position at an airfoil tip, wherein the airfoil has a curve corresponding to a relationship between a trailing edge sweep angle and a span position, wherein the trailing edge sweep angle is in a range of 100 to 200 in a range of 40- 70% span position, and the trailing edge sweep angle is positive from 0% span to at least 95% span.

2. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 1,wherein the trailing edge sweep angle is in a range of 100 to 200 in a range of 50-70% span position.

3. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 2,wherein the trailing edge sweep angle is in a range of 100 to 200 in a range of 60-70% span position.

4. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 3,wherein the trailing edge sweep angle is about 150.

5. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 1,wherein the trailing edge sweep angle is positive from 0%-95% span.

6. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 5,wherein the trailing edge sweep angle transitions from less positive to more positive at greater than an 80% span position.

7. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 5,wherein a positive-most trailing edge sweep angle is at a greater than 50% span position.

8. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 1,wherein a trailing edge sweep angle at the 0% span position and a trailing edge sweep angle at the 100% span position are about the same.

9. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 8,wherein a positive-most trailing edge sweep angle is at about a 70% span position.

10. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 1,wherein a trailing edge sweep angle is within 50 along a portion of the curve from the 0% span position to a 60% span position.

11. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 10,wherein a positive-most trailing edge sweep angle lies along the portion.

12. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 10,wherein a trailing edge sweep angle at the 0% span position and a trailing edge sweep angle at the 100% span position have a differential in a range of 400 to 500.

13. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 1,wherein a positive-most trailing edge sweep angle is within the range of 100 to 200 in the range of 40-70% span position.

14. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 1,wherein the airfoil has a curve corresponding to a relationship between a leading edge sweep angle and a span position, wherein a leading edge sweep angle at the 100% span position is less negative than a forward-most leading edge sweep angle along the curve, and wherein the curve has a decreasing leading edge sweep angle rate in a range of a 80-100% span position.

15. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 14,wherein the curve has a portion extending span- wise toward the tip and from the forward-most leading edge sweep angle, the portion has a decreasing leading edge sweep angle that crosses a zero sweep angle in the range of a 30-40% span position.

16. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 15,wherein the forward-most leading edge sweep angle is in a range of -10 to -15±°.

17. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 16,wherein the forward-most leading edge sweep angle is about -10.

18. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 16,wherein a rearward-most leading edge sweep angle is in a range of 150 to 300.

19. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 18,wherein the rearward-most leading edge sweep angle is in a range of 75-85% span position.

20. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 15,wherein a leading edge sweep angle at the 0% span position and a leading edge sweep angle at the 100% span position are within 50 of one another.

21. (Currently amended) The airfoil according toclaim 20,wherein the leading edge sweep angle at the 0% span position and a leading edge sweep angle at the 100% span position are positive __and wherein the airfoil has a relationship between a leading edge dihedral and a span position, the leading edge dihedral negative from 0% span position to 100% span position__.

22. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 15,wherein a leading edge sweep angle at the 0% span position is negative, and a leading edge sweep angle at the 100% span position is positive.

23. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 22,wherein the leading edge sweep angle at the 0% span position and the leading edge sweep angle at the 100% span position are within 100 of one another.

24. (Original) The airfoil according toclaim 3,wherein a leading edge sweep angle at the 0% span position is positive, and a leading edge sweep angle at the 100% span position is negative.

25. (Currently amended) The airfoil according toclaim 1,wherein the airfoil is a fan blade for a gas turbine engine __and wherein the airfoil has a relationship between a leading edge dihedral and a span position, the leading edge dihedral negative from 0% span position to 100% span position__.

26. (Currently amended) A gas turbine engine comprising: a combustor section arranged between a compressor section and a turbine section; a fan section having an array of twenty-six or fewer fan blades, wherein the fan section has a low fan pressure ratio of less than 1.55 __and greater than 1.3__; a geared architecture coupling the fan section to the turbine section or the compressor section; and wherein the fan blades include an airfoil having pressure and suction sides, the airfoil extends in a radial direction from a 0% span position at an inner flow path location to a 100% span position at an airfoil tip, wherein the airfoil has a curve corresponding to a relationship between a trailing edge sweep angle and a span position, wherein the trailing edge sweep angle is in a range of 100 to 200 in a range of 40-70% span position, and the trailing edge sweep angle is positive from 0% span to at least 95% span.

27. (Currently amended) A gas turbine engine comprising: a combustor section arranged between a compressor section and a turbine section; a fan section has a low fan pressure ratio of less than 1.55 __and greater than 1.3__; and wherein the fan blades include an airfoil having pressure and suction sides, the airfoil extends in a radial direction from a 0% span position at an inner flow path location to a 100% span position at an airfoil tip, wherein the airfoil has a curve corresponding to a relationship between a trailing edge sweep angle and a span position, wherein the trailing edge sweep angle is in a range of 100 to 200 in a range of 40-70% span position, and the trailing edge sweep angle is positive from 0% span to at least 95% span.

28. (Original) The gas turbine engine according toclaim 27,wherein the low fan pressure ratio is less than 1.52.

29. (Original) The gas turbine engine according toclaim 28,wherein the low fan pressure ratio is less than 1.50.

30. (Original) The gas turbine engine according toclaim 29,wherein the low fan pressure ratio is less than 1.48.
